task_semantics: Aligned tool tip and sustained surface contact; no tightening mechanism.

analysis.force_reduction: Maximum of the 10 physics substeps in each control step.
analysis.translation_reference: Tool position in the gripper frame at the first retention-active step.

comparison.camera_rule: Both trajectories use the baseline camera at each identical timestamp.
